name: repository-health-assessment
description: Read-only repository health assessment: weighted coverage, six required lanes plus declared optional lanes with per-dimension claim support, an anchored A-F grade with caps and confidence, review-* reports translated into lane claims, a validated Evidence Recon sidecar, and a candidate ledger routed to the architecture and integrity skills.

consumers.codebase-integrity-audit-loop: candidate ledger rows (recommended_action direct-fix | fitness-check | triage); reconciles and hands off, never called by this skill
consumers.architecture-improvement-intelligence: bare spine-v3 candidate plus optional health_context (recommended_action design | prototype)
consumers.repository-improvement-assessment: ria.owner-return@1 with the health artifact reference and an evidence-recon specialist_ref

depends_on.provides: canonical candidate contract, the eight 1-5 scores, priority_score, dedup rules, and lifecycle schema
executable verification and rendering of the candidate half of the shared spine
depends_on.failure_mode: verifyHealth reports ledger-module-missing; the report renders a red candidate panel and does not ship

depends_on.provides: canonical generic evidence packet, coverage/evidence/epistemic vocabulary, negative-claim receipts, and contradiction state
packet validation, inline/expedition mode guidance, and deterministic expedition-lane merge
depends_on.failure_mode: the generic evidence sidecar does not validate or ship; health grading remains owned by the health island and is never hand-repaired

depends_on.provides: aggressive assessment scheduling, cache, and performance receipts
generic bounded executor semantics for read-only worker scheduling
shared ask/generate/skip/inherit report-presentation contract and machine-lean validation
repository-local ignored storage for assessment artifacts, evidence, verification, reports, cache, and scratch
review-fitness-report/v1 contract consumed by assets/review-to-claims.js
depends_on.failure_mode: review workers are recorded in evidence_workers with a limitation; lanes keep their RHA-native evidence

depends_on.provides: translation of a review-fitness-report/v1 into health lane claims carrying review_source
depends_on.failure_mode: the review report yields zero claims and one limitation for the lane

depends_on.provides: review-fitness-report/v1 for the lanes mapped in REVIEW-LANES.md
depends_on.condition: at least one owning lane in REVIEW-LANES.md is active

ria.owner-return@1 shape written by write-health-artifact.js --ria-envelope --return-out

known_risk: This package validates health provenance, projects a conservative generic Evidence Recon sidecar, and delegates candidate scoring, dependency, eligibility, ranking, lifecycle, and rendering to the canonical shared spine. Missing or incompatible required modules are hard failures. The sidecar never owns or alters the health grade.

dev_dependencies.ajv: ^8 — used only by assets/parity-check.js, never by the generated report
dev_dependencies.ledger-verify.js: required for parity-check.js and package-check.js; resolved from shared/candidate-ledger-spine or LEDGER_VERIFY_PATH
dev_dependencies.evidence-recon.js: required for package-check.js and evidence-recon-projection.js; resolved from shared/evidence-recon, EVIDENCE_RECON_PATH, or an explicit path

performance.surface_inventory: parallel deterministic construction; frozen before final grading
performance.verification_under_ria: consume shared assessment-verification baseline; targeted re-verification only

presentation.canonical_machine_artifact: validated health island + candidate ledger + Evidence Recon sidecar

consumers: repository-improvement-assessment via owner-return specialist_refs kind evidence-recon

input_profiles._note: RUNTIME-CONTRACT.json carries only the ria profile, because shared/assessment-runtime-contract validates a closed input {required, optional} shape. Standalone is documented here.

constraints.candidate_namespace: string "health"; every candidate_id minted under RIA is "health:<local>"
